## Learning outcome

Identify how a partition key can create a hotspot.

::: {.notes}
Prerequisites: Lectures 04, 06, and 10. This is a sample deck for the proposed syllabus, not a full lecture.
:::

## Worked scenario

Registrations are partitioned by course identifier. One very popular course receives most requests during enrolment.

::: {.notes}
Partitioning assigns different data to different nodes. The chosen key affects both query routing and load distribution. Evenly dividing identifiers does not guarantee evenly dividing traffic.
:::

## Discussion and recap

Why might adding nodes leave the popular course as a bottleneck?

**Takeaway:** Evaluate the request distribution as well as the data distribution.

::: {.notes}
Ask students to name assumptions before proposing a solution. The complete planned scope is recorded in the lecture brief.
:::
